name: frontleap-qa-admin
description: Frontleap Platform Admin MCP server for a QA Frontleap origin (Clerk OAuth at connect).

FRONTLEAP_URL.title: Frontleap QA origin
FRONTLEAP_URL.description: Public origin for the Frontleap QA app you are using (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). Example: https://slug.frontleap.com. The plugin appends the fixed admin MCP path.

OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: OAuth client ID
OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Static OAuth 2.0 client ID for Clerk MCP connect (set in Plugins -> Configure; not stored in the repo).

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.title: OAuth client secret
OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Static OAuth 2.0 client secret for Clerk MCP connect (set in Plugins -> Configure; not stored in the repo).
